game: Grand Theft Auto III - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: 100% completion requirements
findings.detail: 50 story missions (Give Me Liberty to The Exchange); 17 pay phone missions (8 Portland, 4 Staunton, 5 Shoreside); Firefighter 60 fires (20 per island); Paramedic level 12; Taxi 100 fares; Vigilante 60 criminals (20 per island); 4 Off-Road challenges (A Ride in the Park, Gripped!, Multistorey Mayhem, Patriot Playground); 4 RC Toyz missions; 3 Import/Export lists (Portland Garage, Portland Crane, Shoreside Garage); 20 Rampages; 20 Unique Stunt Jumps; 100 Hidden Packages.
findings.trackable: Completion percentage on Pause > Stats screen (first line per PowerPyx/Steam post).

findings.name: Not required for 100%
findings.detail: Criminal rating 2,500 / 5,000 and delivering 10 Securicars to Portland Harbor Garage are not part of 100%.
findings.trackable: Criminal Rating is shown at top of Stats screen.

findings.name: Order-dependent story missions (10 missable missions)
findings.detail: GTABase says 10 missable missions exist but does not list them. Ordering rules: finish all Joey and Luigi missions before 'Last Requests' (Salvatore); finish all Kenji Kasen missions before 'Waka-Gashira Wipeout!' (Donald Love); finish 'Two-Faced Tanner' before 'Grand Theft Aero'. PowerPyx also mentions Asuka's missions ordering.
findings.trackable: Missing missions show against completion % in Stats.

findings.name: Mission-specific trophies (PowerPyx: missable)
findings.detail: Without a Scratch (Mike Lips' car, first attempt, no damage); Mob Boss (both mafia survive Triads and Tribulations); Planned Ahead (Chunky Lee Chong killed with bomb-rigged car); Got This Figured Out (all 8 prostitutes picked up by coach in The Fuzz Ball); 100% trophy glitchable.
findings.trackable: No counter; mission replay availability is not confirmed.

findings.name: Kingdom Come last-item bug
findings.detail: If pay phone mission 'Kingdom Come' is the last 100% item, 'Is That All You've Got?' may not unlock despite 100% in stats. Do it earlier.

findings.name: Purple Nines disappear after D-Ice pay phone missions / Rumble
findings.detail: After D-Ice's phone missions (GTABase says after 'Rumble'), Purple Nines vanish; this reportedly carries over to new playthroughs and can block Uzi Money / 100%. Keep an earlier save.

findings.name: RNG / luck-dependent items
findings.detail: Wreckless Driving (perfect insane stunt) may not happen naturally and one commenter reported it not popping; Paramedic level 12 depends on civilian spawns and timers. Reader reports (unverified): a stunt jump done during a mission may not count as a unique jump; one player's rampage tally stuck at 18/20.

findings.name: Official PS/Xbox achievement list (28 + platinum)
findings.detail: 28 achievements/trophies totalling 1000 G, plus PS5-only platinum 'King of Liberty City' (gta.wiki says PS4 original had 29; DE has 28 plus platinum on PS5 only). Count-based ones: Escape Artist (20 bribes), Street Sweeper (100 gang kills), Wheels Up (20 unique jumps), Come Out to Play-y-y-y (25 melee gang kills), Where To? (100 fares), Liberty City Minute (under 10 HP for 1 min), Full Artillery (every weapon used once), Dirty Money ($1,000,000), Right-hand Man (rating 2,500), Liberty City Secrets (100 packages), Is That All You've Got? (100%), Splish Splash (15 fires in one Fire Truck mission), Going Rogue (15 criminals in one Vigilante mission), Playing Doctor (Paramedic 12). Mission ones: First Day on the Job, A Marked Man, Offshore Delivery, Not So Fast, A Gift from the King, Man Toyz, By a Mile (Turismo under 180s), Disposing of the Evidence, Furious First Responder.
findings.trackable: Most map to Stats screen lines but only completion %, criminal rating confirmed.

findings.name: Rockstar Social Club accomplishments (15 exclusive)
findings.detail: Got Any Stories, Old Man?; Talks a Lot (all phone missions); Blood in the Streets (all 20 rampages); Instigator (10 rampages); Chasing Paper ($500k); Am Walkin' Here (die by being run over); Hunting Season (destroy 5 helicopters); Repeat Offender (busted 20 times); Cheaters Do Prosper! (blow up 2,000 cars); Play Fetch; Pest Control; Relief Pitcher (20 fires one mission); Like a Boss (rating 5,000); Fare Game (pick up Curly Bob in Taxi during Cutting the Grass); Recycler (crush 25 cars). Total 44 on Social Club (gta.wiki). Which platforms receive these is NOT confirmed.
findings.trackable: Not confirmed in-game; tracked on Social Club site.

findings.name: Cheats disable trophies/achievements
findings.detail: Unlike the 2015 PS4 port, DE disables achievements/trophies when cheats are used (PlayStation/Xbox reports). Use a separate save.

findings.name: No difficulty settings; single playthrough
findings.detail: Story ~10 hours; platinum estimated 20-25 hours (PowerPyx). Frequent crashes reported, save often.

trackableStats.where: A commenter says rampages do NOT appear in Stats though required for 100%; unverified. Original game showed Rampages Passed

trackableStats.stat: Hidden packages, unique jumps, fares, etc.
trackableStats.where: Original GTA III Stats showed these; DE Stats entry list NOT confirmed by any source reviewed

versionNotes.note: Switch has no native achievement/trophy system. Rockstar release text mentions 'updated Achievements, Trophies' generally and Social Club accomplishments, but no source confirms Switch gets either. One article (Gaming Nexus) frames Social Club accomplishments as a PC feature. Treat Switch achievement support as UNCONFIRMED, likely none.

No Nintendo Switch 2 Edition of the Trilogy found. One retailer listing claims Switch 2 compatibility (backward compatibility, locked 30fps, faster loads) - weak, unverified. Treat as Switch 1 game running on Switch 2 via backward compatibility.

Switch launched Nov 11, 2021 digitally; physical release Feb 11, 2022 (initially requiring download; later reprint reportedly without). Switch version has gyro aiming, touchscreen camera/menu controls. Launch performance was heavily criticised (VGC, TechRadar, Nintendo Life 4/10).

Update 1.112-era patch (restored sky/clouds/fog) shipped on PS5, Xbox Series, PC first; Switch patch was pending per Pocket Tactics. Switch lags other platforms in patches; current Switch patch level not confirmed.
Original 2015 PS4 GTA III had 29 trophies; was delisted/replaced by DE on Nov 11 2021. DE has 17 new achievements/trophies vs that port per GTABase.
Platinum 'King of Liberty City' is PlayStation-only. Social Club version requires all other 43 in the same playthrough.
